# Point Loma Nazarene University

> > Point Loma Nazarene University is a Christian liberal arts university in San Diego offering undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on nursing, health sciences, and faith-integrated education.

PLNU features distinguished faculty across multiple disciplines, with particular strength in nursing education including family nurse practitioner, psychiatric-mental health, and palliative care programs. The university maintains partnerships with leading healthcare institutions including UC San Diego, Sharp Healthcare, and the University of San Diego.

## Nursing Faculty

- [Michelle Jackson, PhD, MSN, ANP-BC, PMHNP-BC](https://www.pointloma.edu/faculty/michelle-jackson-phd-msn-anp-bc-pmhnp-bc): Nursing professor with dual board certification in adult-gerontology and psychiatric-mental health nurse practitioner specialties, expertise in palliative care and geriatric nursing
